segments.name: Platform
segments.description: AI-powered platform for teams to collaborate on digital product design, development, and delivery throughout the entire software creation lifecycle.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its operations and allocates resources as a single operating segment at the consolidated level.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees for platform access based on number of seats and subscription plan tier, invoiced monthly or annually.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company primarily derives its revenue from sales of subscriptions for access to its platform.
